bodies: Association of State and Provincial Psychology Boards
American Association of Sexuality Educators, Counselors and Therapists
Qualified Applied Behavior Analysis Credentialing Board
Association for Death Education and Counseling
National Register of Health Service Psychologists

exams.name: Certified Clinical Mental Health Counselor
exams.blurb: NBCC speciality credential layered on the NCC, requiring clinical coursework, supervised hours and a taped work sample or clinical examination.

exams.name: National Certified Counselor
exams.blurb: Voluntary national counseling credential awarded after graduate study, supervised experience and a passing score on the NCE or NCMHCE.

exams.name: National Certified School Counselor
exams.blurb: School counseling speciality credential for National Certified Counselors working in K-12 settings, requiring supervised school experience.

exams.name: National Clinical Mental Health Counseling Examination
exams.blurb: Case-based clinical examination used for mental health counselor licensure, assessing diagnosis, treatment planning and clinical decision making.

exams.name: National Counselor Examination for Licensure and Certification
exams.blurb: Multiple-choice licensure examination testing counseling theory, human growth, assessment, groups, career development, research and ethics.

exams.name: NBCC Master Addictions Counselor
exams.blurb: Addictions speciality credential for National Certified Counselors, requiring addiction coursework, supervised hours and the examination for MAC.

exams.name: ASWB Advanced Generalist Examination
exams.blurb: Licensure examination for master-level social workers in advanced non-clinical practice, covering macro practice, supervision and programme evaluation.

exams.name: ASWB Associate Examination
exams.blurb: Entry ASWB examination used by a small number of jurisdictions for associate-level social work roles below the bachelor category.

exams.name: ASWB Bachelors Examination
exams.blurb: Entry licensure examination for BSW graduates covering human development, assessment, intervention and professional values and ethics.

exams.name: ASWB Clinical Examination
exams.blurb: Examination required for clinical social work licensure, focused on diagnosis, psychotherapy, treatment planning and clinical ethics.

exams.name: ASWB Masters Examination
exams.blurb: Licensure examination for MSW graduates covering assessment, intervention planning, service delivery and professional relationships and ethics.

exams.name: Certificate of Professional Qualification in Psychology
exams.body: Association of State and Provincial Psychology Boards
exams.blurb: Mobility credential banking a psychologist credentials so participating jurisdictions can grant licensure without a full re-review.

exams.name: Examination for Professional Practice in Psychology Part 1 (Knowledge)
exams.body: Association of State and Provincial Psychology Boards
exams.blurb: Standardised 225-item licensure examination covering biological bases, assessment, treatment, research methods and professional ethics.

exams.name: Examination for Professional Practice in Psychology Part 2 (Skills)
exams.body: Association of State and Provincial Psychology Boards
exams.blurb: Competency-based companion examination measuring applied psychological skills, adopted by a growing number of licensing jurisdictions.

exams.name: Interjurisdictional Practice Certificate
exams.body: Association of State and Provincial Psychology Boards
exams.blurb: PSYPACT credential allowing qualified psychologists to provide telepsychology across participating states under the compact.

exams.name: Approved Clinical Supervisor
exams.blurb: National credential for counselors who supervise, requiring graduate supervision coursework, supervised practice hours and endorsement of competence.

exams.name: Board Certified TeleMental Health Provider
exams.blurb: Credential for licensed clinicians delivering therapy by video and phone, covering technology, law, ethics and remote crisis management.

exams.name: Distance Credentialed Counselor
exams.blurb: Training-based credential preparing licensed counselors to deliver distance services safely, covering screening, ethics, technology and documentation.

exams.name: Global Career Development Facilitator
exams.blurb: Credential for career support practitioners covering assessment, labour market information, programme management and helping skills.

exams.name: Board Certified Assistant Behavior Analyst
exams.blurb: Undergraduate-level ABA credential for practitioners who deliver behaviour-analytic services under the supervision of a BCBA.

exams.name: Board Certified Behavior Analyst
exams.blurb: Graduate-level certification for behaviour analysts, requiring accredited coursework, supervised fieldwork and a 185-question examination.

exams.name: Board Certified Behavior Analyst — Doctoral
exams.blurb: Doctoral designation added to an active BCBA certification for analysts holding a qualifying doctorate in behaviour analysis or a related field.

exams.name: Registered Behavior Technician
exams.blurb: Paraprofessional ABA credential requiring forty hours of training, a competency assessment and an eighty-five question multiple-choice examination.

exams.name: AASECT Certified Sex Therapist
exams.body: American Association of Sexuality Educators, Counselors and Therapists
exams.blurb: Certification for licensed psychotherapists completing sexuality coursework, a sexual attitude reassessment and supervised sex therapy hours.

exams.name: AASECT Certified Sexuality Counselor
exams.body: American Association of Sexuality Educators, Counselors and Therapists
exams.blurb: Credential for practitioners providing short-term sexuality counselling, requiring core sexuality training and supervised counselling experience.

exams.name: AASECT Certified Sexuality Educator
exams.body: American Association of Sexuality Educators, Counselors and Therapists
exams.blurb: Credential for professionals delivering sexuality education programmes, requiring sexuality coursework, teaching hours and supervision.

exams.name: Applied Behavior Analysis Technician
exams.body: Qualified Applied Behavior Analysis Credentialing Board
exams.blurb: QABA entry credential for paraprofessionals implementing behaviour plans, requiring forty hours of training and a proctored examination.

exams.name: Qualified Autism Services Practitioner-Supervisor
exams.body: Qualified Applied Behavior Analysis Credentialing Board
exams.blurb: Mid-tier QABA credential for bachelor-level practitioners who supervise technicians and implement autism intervention programmes.

exams.name: Qualified Behavior Analyst
exams.body: Qualified Applied Behavior Analysis Credentialing Board
exams.blurb: Master-level QABA credential focused on autism and developmental disability services, covering assessment, programme design and supervision.

exams.name: ABPP Board Certification in Clinical Neuropsychology
exams.blurb: Rigorous ABPP speciality board with a written examination, practice samples and oral defence in brain-behaviour assessment and rehabilitation.

exams.name: ABPP Subspecialty Certification in Pediatric Neuropsychology
exams.blurb: Subspecialty credential open to board certified clinical neuropsychologists who demonstrate advanced competence with children and adolescents.

exams.name: BCIA Board Certification in Biofeedback
exams.blurb: Certification requiring didactic education, anatomy coursework, mentored practice and an examination in general biofeedback practice.

exams.name: BCIA Board Certification in Neurofeedback
exams.blurb: Certification in EEG biofeedback covering neuroanatomy, instrumentation, assessment and treatment planning, plus mentored clinical hours.

exams.name: Certification in Thanatology: Death, Dying and Bereavement
exams.body: Association for Death Education and Counseling
exams.blurb: Examination-based credential for grief and bereavement practitioners covering dying, loss, mourning, assessment and intervention.

exams.name: Fellow in Thanatology: Death, Dying and Bereavement
exams.body: Association for Death Education and Counseling
exams.blurb: Advanced ADEC designation for certified thanatologists who document additional professional practice, education and contribution to the field.

exams.name: EMDRIA Approved EMDR Basic Training
exams.blurb: Approved training of at least fifty hours combining instruction, supervised practicum and consultation, and the prerequisite for EMDR certification.

exams.name: EMDRIA Certified Therapist in EMDR Therapy
exams.blurb: Certification requiring completed EMDR basic training, fifty EMDR sessions with clients and twenty hours of consultation with an approved consultant.

exams.name: National Register Health Service Psychologist
exams.body: National Register of Health Service Psychologists
exams.blurb: Credentialing bank verifying doctoral education, internship and supervised experience for licensed psychologists providing health services.
